summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of the ODD/EVEN platform. Backend: 24 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_oddeven_e2e.py, all passing (the bet-after-close test was flaky on timing the first time, then fixed and passed on its own). Covered: register/login/logout, duplicate/weak/invalid-referral rejection, forgot password (recovery code + bank last4, single-use token, sessions revoked), admin password+TOTP MFA, config save + history + pause/resume, verifier creation with temp credentials + forced change + online toggle, deposit routing ('unavailable' when no verifier online), UTR submit, verify once, duplicate UTR, wagering +deposit, referral ₹300 coupon (5x) on a ₹500 verified deposit, daily ₹10 coupon (3x) claim once, withdrawals (min ₹300, wager block, saved-UPI requirement, reserve, approve->processing(ref)->complete, insufficient->reassign, admin reject->refund, offline verifier still sees assigned withdrawals and gets no new deposits), bet validation, idempotent client_key, 1.95x settlement, practice (10 results, no wallet change, admin log), admin credit/debit reauth + debit beyond balance rejected, suspend/reactivate, commission release limited to pending, reports + CSV + reconcile (0 discrepancies) + audit actions. Frontend (Playwright, 390px mobile + 1920 desktop): register->recovery code->game, countdown/status, presets, ODD/EVEN select, PLACE BET toast with bet id and balance debit, reveal + result toast + recent results, practice generate, messages claim, wallet, withdraw wager warning, deposit assign->UTR->verifier portal verify->balance credited, verifier withdrawal approve/record ref/complete, admin MFA login, all 10 admin tabs, create verifier credentials modal, verifier forced pw change + online toggle, admin wallet credit with password+TOTP, config save, reports run/export CSV download, reconcile, practice log, forgot password UI, music file + toggle.

critical.issue: CORS_ORIGINS in backend/.env did not include the public frontend origin https://odd-even-vault.preview.emergentagent.com (only an old ba7962df... preview host). Every POST/PUT from the real UI returned 403 'Origin not allowed', so login/register/bets were all broken. FIXED by tester: prepended the origin to CORS_ORIGINS and restarted the backend. Main agent should keep CORS_ORIGINS in sync with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (or derive it) so this doesn't come back on a fork/deploy.

minor.issue: payment_accounts.find(P, ...) passed {'_id':0} as the FILTER, so 'Payment-account balances' always showed 'No records'. FIXED by tester (find({}, ...)) and a regression assert was added.

Funds are debited/reserved BEFORE inserting the withdrawal doc. Two concurrent requests with the same client_key both pass the dup check; the second insert raises DuplicateKeyError (500) and leaves its reserved funds with no withdrawal record. Insert the doc first (or catch DuplicateKeyError and refund).

Line 292 sets users.status='active' whenever 'status' is not in the update, so editing e.g. display_name on a DISABLED verifier reactivates its login user (vprofile still blocks it, but the states become inconsistent). Only touch users.status when status is in upd.

Doesn't check expires_at. An expired coupon that the 5-min bonus loop hasn't auto-credited yet can still be claimed manually. Result is the same credit, but status shows 'claimed' instead of 'auto_credited'.
Doesn't update an existing admin's password hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes in .env (playbook check 5 fails).

promo_reserve is currently -1000 (negative). risk_gate only enforces it in 'risk' mode, so in random mode promotions keep being issued past the reserve. Switching to risk mode would immediately disable promotions.
The Game Config UI sends every field on save, so config_history entries list all fields as 'changes' even when unchanged. Diff against 'before' to record only real changes.

ui_bugs.issue: Header row has no spare width. In one run the settings gear was clipped at the right edge (settings-button right edge = 394.5px, document scrollWidth 395 > 390) with balance ₹1,200.00; a later run measured 390. A longer balance (e.g. ₹10,000.00) will clearly overflow. Reduce gap/padding, let the balance block shrink (min-w-0/truncate) or drop the Deposit label on small screens.
No loading state: shows 'No coupons yet' / 'No messages' empty states while the fetch is in flight, so the page briefly says there is nothing when coupons/notifications exist.

issues: The withdrawal transfer reference, completion confirmation and reject reasons use native window.prompt/window.confirm instead of styled modals. These look off-brand, and native prompts are blocked on some mobile in-app browsers.
From/To filters use the native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a shadcn Calendar/Popover date picker.

Abandoning an assigned deposit (Continue without submitting a UTR) leaves an 'initiated' record that counts against verifier capacity for 30 min. Consider auto-expiring it or cancelling on Cancel/back.

action_items: Keep backend CORS_ORIGINS in sync with the public frontend URL (tester added https://odd-even-vault.preview.emergentagent.com). Without it, all UI POSTs return 403.
Fix the mobile TopBar width so the settings gear never overflows at 390px with large balances
POST /withdrawals: insert the withdrawal doc before reserving funds, or refund on DuplicateKeyError
PUT /admin/verifiers/{vid}: don't reset users.status unless status is in the update
Coupon claim: reject or auto-credit when expires_at has passed
seed_admin: update password_hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes
Replace window.prompt/confirm in the verifier dashboard with styled dialogs; use the shadcn date picker in Admin Reports
Add a loading state to the Messages page
critical_code_review_comments: Money paths (ledger_credit/ledger_debit with unique keys, conditional $gte debit, settlement via find_one_and_update on status) are idempotent. Reconcile reports 0 discrepancies after all flows.
ledger_debit does check-then-act on the key, then compensates on DuplicateKeyError. That's correct, but under concurrency it briefly double-debits.
routes_admin.py is 577 lines, close to the 700-line limit. Consider splitting reports/reconcile into their own module.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows work; mobile header overflow + minor design items)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/test_oddeven_e2e.py (~70s, creates 2 new users and 1 verifier each run; registration limit is 10/hr/IP). Tests run in order and share state through dict S. The suite sets pv1001 offline at the start and restores it to online at the end. Admin TOTP replay is allowed (pyotp verify, no used-code tracking). Bets require an open round with >4s left; rounds are 30s + 3s reveal.
